sources.title: Phips/4xBHI_dat2_real · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Description: 4x dat2 upscaling model for web and realistic images. It handles realistic noise, some realistic blur, and webp and jpg (re)compression. Trained on my BHI dataset (390'035 training tiles) with degraded LR subset.

sources.title: Core ML | Apple Developer Documentation
sources.snippet: Core ML itself builds on top of low-level primitives like Accelerate and BNNS, as well as Metal Performance Shaders. If your app integrates AI models using the latest architectures and inference techniques, see Core AI.
